title: Haven of Rest Vacation Rental
meta_description: Haven of Rest is a 3.00 bedroom, 2.50 bathroom vacation rental.
description_expanded: DescriptionHaven of RestProminence • Watersound, FL 32461Home Highlights3 bedrooms2.5 bathroomsSleeps 6 guests1,600+ sq. ft.2 community pools with bathrooms (heated seasonally; dates set by the community)2 Free Adult Bikes Included (Not available Dec–Feb; additional rentals available upon request)Pet-Friendly — 1 pet max, 20 lb. limit; $250 non-refundable fee per pet; pets must be listed and approved by 30A CottagesSix-seater golf cart includedWalk to The Big ChillResort-style grilling areasParking for 2 vehicles in driveway (no street parking permitted)Baby Gear - Stroller, pack-n-play, white noise machine, baby monitor, and games Welcome to Haven of RestDiscover serenity at Haven of Rest, a peaceful retreat nestled in the scenic Prominence community on 30A. Surrounded by the natural beauty of a neighboring state park, this home offers quiet mornings, lush landscapes, and the chance to spot native wildlife along winding walking paths. Searching for fun, dining, or family entertainment? You're just a short walk from The Big Chill—a lively hub with great restaurants, boutique shopping, live music, and nightly outdoor movies the whole family will love.Inside, the home welcomes you with a bright, thoughtfully designed layout perfect for relaxing after a day at the beach. With three bedrooms and two and a half bathrooms, Haven of Rest comfortably accommodates up to six guests. The fully equipped kitchen features elegant quartz countertops, stainless steel appliances, and everything you need—from morning coffee to seafood dinners. Unwind in the spacious living room with plush seating and a Smart TV, or step outside to the private balcony overlooking the tranquil state park—an ideal spot for sunrise coffee or evening conversation. Each bedroom is filled with natural light for a refreshing start to the day. The primary suite includes a private ensuite bathroom with a double vanity and a glass walk-in shower for added luxury.Prominence offers some of the best amenities on 30A, making beach days and pool days effortless. Take a leisurely walk, hop on the included bikes, or cruise in the golf cart to reach the sugar-white sands. When you're ready to switch things up, enjoy a dip in one of the two resort-style community pools.Whether you’re seeking adventure or the perfect place to unwind, Haven of Rest is your peaceful retreat in the heart of 30A.About Prominence on 30A – Watersound, FloridaSet along the iconic 30A corridor, Prominence is a highly sought-after community known for its exceptional amenities, well-maintained green spaces, and access to over 17 miles of scenic bike paths. Its ideal central location puts you close to beloved beach towns—Seagrove and Seaside to the west, Alys Beach and Rosemary Beach to the east—and just moments from pristine white-sand beaches.At the center of the community is The Big Chill, a vibrant gathering place featuring a massive 25-foot LED theater screen for sporting events and movies, live music, kids’ activities, dining, and boutique shopping—all just a short walk from your door.Beach Access is Deer Lake State Park which is approximately a 5/7 min bike ride.With endless entertainment, natural beauty, and upscale amenities, Prominence is the perfect setting for a coastal escape.Reservation & Booking PoliciesPlease Note: The cancelation policy and terms of the 30A Cottages & Concierge Vacation Rental Agreement emailed at confirmation supersede any policies listed by third-party booking sites (VRBO, Airbnb, HomeAway, etc.). We cannot reimburse third-party service fees. We do not offer a 100% refund once a booking has been processed. All cancelations incur a 5% fee to cover processing costs.Payment50% of total cost is due at bookingFinal balance is due 60 days prior to arrivalIf booking within 60 days of arrival, full payment is requiredCancelationsExcept for a 5% processing fee, the initial 50% payment is fully refundable if cancelation is made more than 60 days before arrivalTravel InsuranceOptional travel insurance is availableMust be purchased before final payment or at the time the reservation is paid in fullCheck-In / Check-OutCheck-in: 4:00 PM CSTCheck-out: 10:00 AM CSTParkingDriveway parking for 2 vehicles, depending on sizeNo street parking allowedRulesNO SMOKINGPet-Friendly — 1 pet max, 20 lb. limit; $250 non-refundable fee per pet; pet must be listed on reservation and approvedTenant must be 25+ years of age and must occupy the home for the entire stayPublished rates do not include taxes and fees
